title: От Луки 9 — Luke 9
instructions: Choose the correct case form of the word in brackets to fill the blank. Every option is a real form of the same word — only the case differs.

cases.sentence: Среди учеников как-то начался ___ о том, кто из них важнее.
cases.translation: An argument arose among the disciples about who was the greatest.
cases.explain: Спор is the grammatical subject of начался (arose) → nominative, the dictionary form.

cases.sentence: Да ведь у нас только пять ___ и две рыбы, разве что нам пойти и купить еды на всех этих людей?
cases.translation: We have only five loaves and two fish, unless we go and buy food for all these people.
cases.explain: The numeral пять (five) requires the counted noun in genitive plural: пять хлебов.

cases.sentence: Дух терзает его до полного ___ и лишь тогда нехотя отступает.
cases.translation: The spirit torments him to the point of complete exhaustion and only then reluctantly withdraws.
cases.explain: The preposition до (until/to the point of) governs the genitive → изнеможения.

cases.sentence: ...но Иисус приказал нечистому духу выйти, исцелил мальчика, а затем отдал его ___.
cases.translation: But Jesus commanded the unclean spirit to come out, healed the boy, and gave him back to his father.
cases.explain: Отдать (кому) X — the recipient of отдал goes in the dative → отцу.

cases.sentence: Созвав вместе двенадцать, Иисус дал им ___ и власть одолевать всех демонов и излечивать болезни.
cases.translation: Calling the twelve together, Jesus gave them power and authority to overcome all demons and to heal diseases.
cases.explain: Сила is the direct object of дал (gave) → accusative; feminine -а nouns take -у: силу.

cases.translation: And he sought an opportunity to see Jesus.
cases.explain: Иисус is animate masculine and the direct object of увидеть (to see); its accusative equals its genitive form: Иисуса.

cases.sentence: И вот появились два человека, которые стали разговаривать с ___.
cases.translation: And behold, two men appeared who began talking with Jesus.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) governs the instrumental → Иисусом.

cases.sentence: Явившись в славе, они говорили о его исходе, который он должен будет совершить в ___.
cases.translation: Appearing in glory, they spoke of his departure, which he was about to accomplish in Jerusalem.
cases.explain: В (in/at) marking a location, not motion, governs the prepositional → Иерусалиме.

reading.ru: Созвав вместе двенадцать, Иисус дал им силу и власть одолевать всех демонов и излечивать болезни.
reading.question: What did Jesus give the twelve disciples when he called them together?
options: Power and authority over demons and to heal diseases
Money and food for the journey
reading.correct: Power and authority over demons and to heal diseases
reading.explain: Jesus gave them power and authority to overcome all demons and to heal diseases (WEB v.1).

reading.ru: А если где-то люди вас не примут, то, уходя из того города, отряхните пыль с ваших ног, это будет свидетельством против них.
reading.question: What were the disciples told to do if a town did not welcome them?
options: Shake the dust off their feet as a testimony against them
Wait outside the gates until they were welcomed
reading.correct: Shake the dust off their feet as a testimony against them
reading.explain: Jesus said that when people did not receive them, they should shake the dust off their feet as a testimony against that town (WEB v.5).

reading.ru: Он был в недоумении, потому что одни говорили, что это Иоанн воскрес из мертвых, другие, что явился Илия, третьи, что ожил один из древних пророков.
reading.question: Why was Herod perplexed about Jesus?
options: Because people gave conflicting explanations — John risen, Elijah, or an ancient prophet
Because Jesus had never been seen in public
Because Jesus refused to answer Herod's questions
Because Jesus lived outside Herod's territory
reading.correct: Because people gave conflicting explanations — John risen, Elijah, or an ancient prophet
reading.explain: Herod was perplexed because some said John had risen from the dead, others that Elijah had appeared, others that an old prophet had risen (WEB vv.7-8).

reading.ru: Ученики удивились, «Да ведь у нас только пять хлебов и две рыбы, разве что нам пойти и купить еды на всех этих людей?» а там одних только мужчин было около пяти тысяч.
reading.question: How much food did the disciples say they had for the crowd?
options: Only five loaves and two fish
reading.correct: Only five loaves and two fish
reading.explain: The disciples said they had no more than five loaves and two fish for about five thousand men (WEB vv.13-14).

reading.ru: Все ели и насытились и собрали еще двенадцать корзин остатков.
reading.question: What happened after everyone ate the bread and fish?
options: They gathered twelve baskets of leftovers
They ran out of food halfway through
reading.correct: They gathered twelve baskets of leftovers
reading.explain: Everyone ate and was filled, and twelve baskets of broken pieces were gathered up (WEB v.17).

reading.question: How did Peter answer when Jesus asked who the disciples thought he was?
reading.explain: Peter answered, “The Christ of God” (WEB v.20).

reading.ru: Но Иисус строго велел им никому не говорить об этом, сказав, «Сыну человеческому должно много пострадать и быть отвергнутым старейшинами, первосвященниками и учителями закона, он будет убит, но на третий день воскреснет».
reading.question: What did Jesus say must happen to the Son of Man?
options: He must suffer, be rejected, be killed, and rise on the third day
He must be crowned king in Jerusalem
He must travel to Rome to meet Caesar
He must fast for forty days
reading.correct: He must suffer, be rejected, be killed, and rise on the third day
reading.explain: Jesus said the Son of Man must suffer many things, be rejected by the elders, chief priests, and scribes, be killed, and rise on the third day (WEB v.22).

reading.ru: «Говорю вам истину, некоторые из вас, стоящих здесь, не умрут, пока не увидят Божьего Царства».
reading.question: What did Jesus promise some of those standing there?
options: They would not die before seeing God's Kingdom
They would live to see Jerusalem destroyed
reading.correct: They would not die before seeing God's Kingdom
reading.explain: Jesus said some standing there would not taste death until they saw God's Kingdom (WEB v.27).

reading.ru: Во время молитвы его облик вдруг изменился, а одежда стала ослепительно белой.
reading.question: What happened to Jesus' appearance while he was praying on the mountain?
options: His face changed and his clothing became dazzling white
reading.correct: His face changed and his clothing became dazzling white
reading.explain: As he prayed, the appearance of his face was altered and his clothing became white and dazzling (WEB v.29).

reading.ru: Оказавшись в облаке, они очень испугались, а из облака прозвучал голос «Это мой сын, мой избранный, его слушайте».
reading.question: What did the voice from the cloud say?
options: “This is my son, my chosen one, listen to him”
reading.correct: “This is my son, my chosen one, listen to him”
reading.explain: A voice from the cloud said, “This is my beloved Son. Listen to him!” (WEB v.35).

reading.ru: «Я просил твоих учеников изгнать его, но они не смогли».
reading.question: What did the man in the crowd say he had already tried?
options: Asking Jesus' disciples to cast out the spirit, but they could not
Taking his son to a doctor
reading.correct: Asking Jesus' disciples to cast out the spirit, but they could not
reading.explain: The man said he had begged Jesus' disciples to cast out the demon, but they could not (WEB v.40).

reading.question: How did the crowd react after Jesus healed the boy?
options: They were astonished at the majesty of God
They demanded Jesus leave the region
reading.correct: They were astonished at the majesty of God
reading.explain: They were all astonished at the majesty (greatness) of God (WEB v.43).

reading.ru: Сын человеческий будет предан в руки людей».
reading.question: What did Jesus tell his disciples would happen to the Son of Man?
options: He would be delivered into the hands of men
He would leave for another country
reading.correct: He would be delivered into the hands of men
reading.explain: Jesus said, “The Son of Man will be delivered up into the hands of men” (WEB v.44).

reading.ru: Иисус, зная их мысли, взял маленького ребенка и поставил его рядом с собой.
reading.question: What did Jesus do when he perceived the disciples' argument about who was greatest?
options: He took a little child and set him by his side
He sent them away to pray alone
He asked Peter to settle the dispute
reading.correct: He took a little child and set him by his side
reading.explain: Knowing their thoughts, Jesus took a little child and set him by his side (WEB v.47).

reading.ru: Когда Иисусу подошло время быть взятым на небо, он направился в Иерусалим.
reading.question: What did Jesus do as the time approached for him to be taken up to heaven?
options: He gathered a larger crowd of followers
reading.explain: When the days were coming near for him to be taken up, he set his face to go to Jerusalem (WEB v.51).

reading.ru: Иисус ответил, «У лисиц есть норы и у птиц небесных гнезда, а сыну человеческому негде и голову преклонить».
reading.question: How did Jesus describe his own way of life to the man who wanted to follow him?
options: Foxes have holes and birds have nests, but he has nowhere to lay his head
He owned a house in every town
He lived comfortably among the wealthy
He always traveled with plenty of provisions
reading.correct: Foxes have holes and birds have nests, but he has nowhere to lay his head
reading.explain: Jesus said, “The foxes have holes, and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay his head” (WEB v.58).
